page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores running at 2.9 GHz with a single-thread-per-core allocation. The system is equipped with 346.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 6.18 GB of memory per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights strong performance in specific multi-threaded and cryptographic operations. The server achieved a strong PassMark CPU score of 51,481.37 and a strong PassMark CPU encryption test score of 47,417.11. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance is also strong at 262.06 GB/sec. Most notably, the integrated NVIDIA A10 GPU delivers top-tier performance in LLM inference, achieving 9,738.91 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 457.19 tokens/sec for text generation on a small 135M model, as well as 2,464.01 tokens/sec and 89.85 tokens/sec respectively on a medium 7B model. Other metrics, such as stress-ng CPU performance and memory bandwidth, fall within the average range.

Given the dedicated Intel Xeon processor cores and the inclusion of an enterprise-grade NVIDIA Ampere GPU, this server offers a specialized hardware profile. The lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which is a key architectural tradeoff. It is highly suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, medium-scale LLM deployment, database operations, and cryptographic processing, where dedicated compute resources and GPU acceleration are required.
